# ADR-3047: A04: Documented risk acceptance for beta surface 11

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Betas sometimes ship with reduced controls.

## Decision

Programs MAY adopt a documented risk acceptance for beta surface 11 (A04-11) when exposing limited beta features.

## Consequences

Acceptances expire with GA criteria.
